# h3_k8s_versions (Data Source)

Kubernetes versions offered by the managed Kubernetes service. With `from`, also the versions a cluster on that version can be upgraded to (`upgrade_targets`) and the recommended next step (`next_upgrade`). Uses API-key (HMAC) access to h3k8s (`api.h3llo.cloud/api/k8s/v3`): the key must list the project; scope `k8s:read` is enough to read, changes and the kubeconfig (admin credentials) need `k8s:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All versions, and the upgrade targets of a cluster on v1.34.1.
data "h3_k8s_versions" "from_current" {
  from = "v1.34.1"
}

output "next_upgrade" {
  value = data.h3_k8s_versions.from_current.next_upgrade
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `from` (String) Current cluster version, e.g. `v1.34.1`

### Read-Only

- `latest` (String) Latest available version
- `next_upgrade` (String) Recommended next upgrade from `from`
- `upgrade_targets` (List of String) Versions reachable from `from` in one upgrade
- `versions` (Attributes List) Available versions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `node_vm_image` (String) Node VM image of the version
- `version` (String) Version, e.g. `v1.35.9`
